```{r, results="asis"}
plate_layouts_chunk_text <- c(
  '```{r, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 10}',
  'OlinkAnalyze::olink_displayPlateLayout(data = plate_list[["{{plate}}"]], fill.color = "{{display_col}}", include.label = include_label) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(paste0("{{plate}}", ": ", "{{display_col}}"))',
  '```\n'
)

out <- NULL
for (plate in names(plate_list)) {
  out <- c(out, knitr::knit_expand(text = "## {{plate}} {.tabset}\n"))
  for (display_col in display_cols) {
    out <- c(out, knitr::knit_expand(text = "### {{display_col}}"))
    out <- c(out, knitr::knit_expand(text = plate_layouts_chunk_text))
  }
}
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = out, quiet = TRUE), sep = '\n')
```
